function_probe.method: Independent offline Rust program copies exact pinned hotwords.rs, creates fictional model/shared/audio directories and minimal fictional BPE data, holds a Windows directory handle with FILE_SHARE_READ and the same open flags, calls actual vocabulary function before and after creating model/bpe.model.
function_probe.preparation_note: First Cargo invocation stopped before compiling because its temporary crate was nested under another workspace. An independent workspace declaration was added and the probe then passed.

limits: Separate synthetic directory trials on one machine; counts are not a cross-system failure rate.
The isolated program exercises the exact hotwords vocabulary function and equivalent native directory-open flags, not the complete product receipt or worker lifecycle.
It establishes local child creation and vocabulary selection drift but does not show a real worker loading a tampered user model or any actual exploitation.
No user model, microphone, recording, GPU, or network data was used.
